claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Ro-19-4605 is a benzodiazepine-site GABA-A receptor inverse agonist with no known cytotoxic pharmacophore, and at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
